lines: Nine hundred and fifty years he called them... then the flood came.
Hazrat Nuh, alayhis salaam, called his people night and day. Only a few believed.
So Allah told him: build the ship, under Our eyes.
Then rain poured from the sky, springs burst from the earth, and the ship sailed through waves like mountains.
Then: O earth, swallow your water. O sky, withhold. And the ship came to rest on Judiyy.
